description:
Code and derived data for an independent, release-history evaluation of the World Bank's ML-imputed Real-Time Food Prices (RTFP) for Bangladesh: 110 markets, four items (rice, wheat flour, palm oil, lentils), judged against survey values that arrived after each of 83 archived releases (2024-01-25 to 2026-10-05). One command rebuilds every table, results note and figure from the original sources (data cutoff RTFP_AS_OF = 2026-10-05). All results are exploratory; the prospective confirmatory analysis plan is registered at OSF (https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/3TJWN).

Code: MIT. Derived tables: CC BY 4.0. Files in data/third_party/bbs/ are Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics data under BBS's own terms (acknowledgement, no commercial reproduction) and are not covered by MIT or CC BY. Independent research; not affiliated with or endorsed by the World Bank, WFP, BBS or TCB.
